item.title: How I make posters for scientific events
item.description:
A poster for an event has a difficult job. It must attract attention, explain what the event is, and give the practical information in a few seconds. At the same time, it may need to contain portraits, talk titles, logos, a timetable, and a QR code.

I learned most of my workflow while preparing posters for PRAPI (Ph.D. Research Activity Presentation) and FNIP (Focus on Optical Neuro-Imaging and Photonics). I make the final composition in Inkscape, but I also use small scripts when a background or a repeated layout can be generated more easily than it can be drawn.
